correctness.rationale: Q=(10^6-1)/9=111111=3*7*11*13*37, and R_(m+6)-R_m=10^m Q give rigorous periodic reduction for every positive padding m and t modulo 6. Prime-wise inverse residue roots modulo the five prime factors produce an exact OR-of-primes test for each of 24 digit/length pairs. Independent full enumeration of 6Q=666666 modular states using both direct arbitrary-precision gcd and CRT-root logic reproduces (60,10121,111,10121,60,10101) and the specified div3/div11 counts. For nonmultiples of 3, digit-3/9 reduced Q/3 candidates and digit-1 obstructions exclude odd-length candidates and force 11 for even t. Since all lengths/centers map into the full finite state space, this is a complete finite certificate, not finite sampling extrapolated to an infinite assertion.
residual_risks: Only divisibility by primes of fixed Q; failure of Q-cover is not evidence of padded primality or of global conjecture resolution.
